question: Does inexpensive learned local encoding improve recurrent adaptation beyond the original network, active parameter matching and fixed random features?
hypothesis: FTA must improve over active capacity controls and avoid stationary degradation before independent confirmation; this first stage does not establish sparse-locality causality, recurrent memory or biological-topology value.

selection.rule: Proposed author-default anchors and named mechanism controls. No HPO is performed by this protocol. Resolve exact versions/configurations and seed reservation in a new registered external protocol before execution. Any later method-specific HPO is a separate study with equal declared search resources; freeze selection before independent confirmation.

config.width_rule: argmin absolute active trainable parameter difference to FTA, integer shared widths32..512, tie smaller

implementation: Qualify original independent 128x128 Linear/affine-free-LayerNorm/LeakyReLU actor and critic before replacing the final activation.
For the selected FTA variant verify 8 tiles plus shifted ReLU tail gives9 outputs, then publish separate actor/critic parameter counts and residual mismatch.
Verify applied-action clipping, reward timing, physical target reachability and fixed-target learnability before hidden GoalSwitch runs.
mechanism: Only encoding changes in stage A; no StreamRate, auxiliary prediction/reconstruction loss, structure growth or extra task information.
Stage B separately tests persistent memory U and current-step computation: memory K1 vs shared K4 vs compute-matched unshared depth4; one environmental arrival remains one update event.

Stage C separately tests dense/self-only/random/module sparse sharing with hard masks across forward, gradients, traces and optimizer slots; stage D adds real biological topology only against matched rewiring.
performance: Compare FTA with original MLP, active parameter-matched MLP and fixed features while preserving full external Stream-AC/Metatrace/Intentional-AC panel.
Evaluate full-lifetime raw reward, recovery/recurrence, stationary noninferiority and resource cost; representation metrics cannot substitute for control reward.
Predeclare independent confirmation and changed schedule/memory demands; no biological-graph efficacy conclusion follows from this pilot.

registration_requirements: Pin and hash original external code and exact dependency closure; qualify any equation ports separately.
Replace every UNREGISTERED placeholder and method-default label with exact numeric configuration; revalidate and freeze a new protocol.
Verify task reward/action/clocks and bootstrap semantics, no boundary label reaches policy, and all baseline interfaces are supported.
Reserve exclusive job/seed namespace and independent output locations; never mutate or relaunch a frozen existing population.
Predeclare task-specific failure interpretation and minimum-effect margins; the scalar floor here is a provisional composite pilot outcome, not an imputed reward or cross-task calibrated score.
Do not aggregate unnormalized raw rewards across tasks; produce task-stratified statistics and registered within-task margins.

secondary: prechange-anchored recovery on comparable reward scales
A-return early reward versus first A with no reset
per-seed failure type/time and resource cost
analysis_plan.multiplicity: Predeclare contrasts per task; adjustment family and practical margins require registration. Do not pool raw rewards across Pendulum/Reacher.
analysis_plan.confirmation: Independent lifetimes and held-out schedule families after full development/HPO selection; include altered dwell times, gradual drift, cue/memory variants where relevant, and longer horizons.
